info.title: WhatsApp CRM API
info.description:
Authenticate with an API key from Settings > API keys: `Authorization: Bearer wak_...`.

Scopes: contacts:read, contacts:write, conversations:read, messages:send, templates:read, campaigns:read, campaigns:write, tags:read, tags:write, hooks:manage.

Lists use cursor pagination: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`. Rate limits are per key, reported in `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

Webhooks are signed: `X-Wacrm-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`, an HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` using the endpoint’s secret. Reject old timestamps, and dedupe on `X-Wacrm-Event-Id`, since delivery is at least once.
